scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dataDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data'); if (!fs.existsSync(dataDir)) { fs.mkdirSync(dataDir, { recursive: true }); } const copyRecursiveSync = function(src, dest) { const exists = fs.existsSync(src); const stats = exists && fs.statSync(src); const isDirectory = exists && stats.isDirectory(); if (isDirectory) { if (!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest); fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(function(childItemName) { copyRecursiveSync(path.join(src, childItemName), path.join(dest, childItemName)); }); } else { fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); } }; try { copyRecursiveSync(path.join(process.cwd(), '..', 'Deep_Baselines', 'data', 'USGs'), path.join(dataDir, 'USGs')); copyRecursiveSync(path.join(process.cwd(), '..', 'Proposed_Models'), path.join(dataDir, 'Proposed_Models')); console.log('Data copied successfully.'); } catch (e) { console.error('Error copying data, this might be normal on Vercel if data is already committed:', e); }"
